statement: Between 2026-09-20 and 2026-10-04, at least one additional commercial or military vessel will be struck, hit, or attacked while transiting the Strait of Hormuz.
resolution: UKMTO issues an advisory, or two independent wire services such as Reuters, AP, or AFP report, that a vessel was struck, hit, or attacked while transiting the Strait of Hormuz between 2026-09-20 and 2026-10-04.
failure_condition: No commercial or military vessel is struck, hit, or attacked while transiting the Strait of Hormuz at any point during the window.

statement: Between 2026-09-20 and 2026-10-11, a Yemeni government-aligned force, Saudi-led coalition, or multinational naval task force will reclaim physical control of a Bab el-Mandeb-area port or checkpoint that Houthi forces held as of 2026-09-13.
resolution: Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP, or AFP report that anti-Houthi forces have retaken a Bab el-Mandeb-area port, town, or checkpoint held by Houthi forces as of 2026-09-13, with the retaking dated between 2026-09-20 and 2026-10-11.
failure_condition: No Houthi-held port, town, or checkpoint on or near the Bab el-Mandeb strait reverts to anti-Houthi control during the window.

statement: WTI crude oil, reference 100.05 dollars per barrel at the prior-session close reported in the 2026-09-13 packet, will settle at or above 112.00 dollars per barrel on any NYMEX trading day between 2026-09-21 and 2026-10-19.
resolution: The NYMEX front-month WTI settlement price, reference 100.05 dollars per barrel on the 2026-09-13 packet date, is 112.00 dollars per barrel or higher on at least one trading day between 2026-09-21 and 2026-10-19.
failure_condition: NYMEX front-month WTI settlement never reaches 112.00 dollars per barrel on any trading day in the window.

statement: A CVE tied to the Tencent-application flaw used to deploy GrayRabbit malware, or to the passkey-phishing campaign hijacking Microsoft cloud accounts, will be added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded between 2026-09-20 and 2026-10-25.
resolution: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog lists a CVE matching the Tencent-app GrayRabbit exploitation chain or the Microsoft cloud passkey-phishing campaign, with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-20 and 2026-10-25.
failure_condition: No CVE tied to either the Tencent-app exploitation chain or the Microsoft cloud passkey-phishing campaign is added to the CISA KEV catalog during the window.

statement: Between 2026-09-20 and 2026-12-01, the Kosovo governing coalition approved on or around 2026-09-13 will lose a Kuvendi confidence vote or formally dissolve.
resolution: Reuters, AP, or Al Jazeera report, or the Kuvendi record shows, that Kosovo's coalition government formed around 2026-09-13 lost a confidence vote or formally dissolved between 2026-09-20 and 2026-12-01.
failure_condition: Kosovo's governing coalition formed around September 13, 2026, neither loses a confidence vote nor formally dissolves during the window.

statement: Between 2026-09-20 and 2026-11-01, the UK Electoral Commission or another UK regulator will open, or confirm it has opened, a formal investigation into the GBP72 million in Reform UK donations from Christopher Harborne and Ben Delo.
resolution: The Electoral Commission publishes, or the BBC, Guardian, or Financial Times report, confirmation that a UK regulator opened a formal investigation into the GBP72 million Reform UK donations between 2026-09-20 and 2026-11-01.
failure_condition: Neither the Electoral Commission nor another UK regulator opens or confirms a formal investigation into the GBP72 million Reform UK donations during the window.

statement: Between 2026-09-20 and 2026-10-11, Hampshire police will arrest at least one of the six men whose images were released in connection with the Portsmouth violent-disorder incident.
resolution: Hampshire Constabulary, the BBC, or the Guardian report the arrest of at least one of the six men named in the Portsmouth violent-disorder appeal, with the arrest dated between 2026-09-20 and 2026-10-11.
failure_condition: None of the six men sought in the Portsmouth violent-disorder appeal is arrested during the window.

statement: Between 2026-09-21 and 2026-11-08, a US House or Senate committee will hold a formal hearing explicitly framed around AI safety or AI regulation.
resolution: The Congress.gov committee schedule, or a House or Senate committee website, lists a hearing explicitly framed around AI safety or AI regulation held between 2026-09-21 and 2026-11-08.
failure_condition: No House or Senate committee holds a hearing explicitly framed around AI safety or AI regulation during the window.

statement: Between 2026-09-14 and 2026-09-27, the confirmed death toll from the September 13, 2026 Java Sea ferry capsizing will reach or exceed 50.
resolution: BASARNAS, Reuters, AP, or Al Jazeera report a confirmed death toll of 50 or more from the September 13, 2026 Java Sea ferry capsizing, dated between 2026-09-14 and 2026-09-27.
failure_condition: The confirmed death toll from the September 13 Java Sea ferry disaster remains below 50 through the end of the window.
